verdict: The accepted version softens the framing (title, abstract, 'for the first time', 'novel') and adds a physical argument for why the pump phase does not reach the k ≈ 0 condensate, plus a pump-phase reference in the Fig. 2 histograms. It also adds a dispersion diagram, an estimate of the antenna's wavevector selectivity, an explicit coherence-value formula with a baseline explanation, a discussion of coherence oscillations, sample dimensions and a Zenodo data deposit. The core data and figures are otherwise unchanged; no new control measurement, phase statistic, power series or second sample was added. The old review anticipated nearly all inferred requests, especially S1, S3, S6, S9 and S10, but several of its major experimental demands (S4, S5, S7, S13) left no trace.

inferred_requests.title: Show that the pump does not imprint the condensate phase
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked how the uniform phase histogram excludes phase transfer from the pump, and for a reference showing the setup's phase stability. The authors added a theoretical argument that parametric pairs carry no global phase into the k ≈ 0 mode and added the pump phase distribution to the Fig. 2 histograms.

inferred_requests.title: Tone down the claims of proof and novelty
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely objected to 'confirm all postulated fundamental properties', 'for the first time', 'novel' and the strong 'spontaneous' framing. Title, abstract and Discussion were softened.

inferred_requests.title: Explain what is new relative to earlier coherence observations
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked why previous magnon-BEC work could not see spontaneous phase formation and pointed to related work such as ³He magnon BEC. The authors added that BLS averages over many cycles and added references.

inferred_requests.title: Show the dispersion and where condensation happens
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for the spectrum of the out-of-plane film, the pumping scheme and the band-bottom location of the condensate. A new Fig. 1b shows the dispersion with pump, f_p/2 and the BEC.

inferred_requests.title: Account for the antenna's wavevector and frequency selectivity
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely questioned the claim that detection is blind to parametric magnons and whether the coherence rise reflects the detection window. The authors added an estimate of the antenna filter and noted that no coherent signal at f_p/2 is seen.

inferred_requests.title: Define the coherence value precisely and explain its baseline
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for the exact definition and normalization of the coherence metric, why it is not zero for noise, the role of the 100 ns window, and what the shaded bands mean. Methods now give a formula, a baseline explanation and the window trade-off; error bands are defined.

inferred_requests.title: Explain when the condensate forms and the structure of the coherence curve
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely noted that coherence rises during pumping and asked about the dip and oscillations after pump-off. The text now places the onset during pumping and adds a tentative explanation for the plateau oscillations.

inferred_requests.title: Make the data available
inferred_requests.text: Referees or the journal likely asked for open data given the custom analysis. Data are now on Zenodo with source data.

inferred_requests.title: Explain the origin of the frequency drift
inferred_requests.text: Referees may have asked why the frequency shifts down after pump-off. The Fig. 3 caption now points to a new Supplementary Section 2, which we cannot see.

inferred_requests.title: Give sample details
inferred_requests.text: Referees may have asked for sample geometry; the lateral dimensions and antenna width were added, which also support the edge-reflection explanation.

inferred_requests.title: State the broader significance and the role of the pumping geometry
inferred_requests.text: A referee or editor may have asked about implications for magnon transport and how pumping geometry affects bottom-magnon population. The Discussion adds an outlook on transverse pumping for supercurrents and Josephson dynamics.

issue_status.reason: A theoretical argument on uncorrelated parametric pairs and a pump-phase reference were added, but phase diffusion from shot-to-shot frequency or onset jitter is not addressed and no band-bottom control is shown.

The pump phase distribution is now shown beside the magnon histograms, but how it was measured is not described and the Extended Data caption still says the oscilloscope was excluded from the locking.

A dispersion diagram was added and 'confirm all postulated' removed, but there is no thermalization evidence, no critical-density estimate and no engagement with the Demokritov comment; 'true BEC' wording remains.
No phase statistic or time-resolved uniformity test was added.
The Fig. 4 threshold text is unchanged; the parametric threshold and pump-power reference point are not given.
The formula, baseline and window trade-off are now explained and error bands defined, but there is no calibration and the 3.5 μs remanence claim is unchanged.
'the BEC does not undergo dephasing' remains without a within-shot phase-diffusion measurement.
Onset is now placed during pumping and the plateau oscillations get a tentative explanation, but no histograms at the earliest coherent time are added.
'For the first time' and 'novel' were removed, the BLS averaging argument and the ³He reference added; Demidov 2008 is still cited only for geometry and 'no direct proof of randomness' remains.
The antenna's wavevector filter and detection window are now estimated, and the absence of a coherent f_p/2 signal is reported.
The Extended Data caption on the 3.77 GHz band and shadow is unchanged; any mixer calibration would be in the Supplementary, which we do not have.
A Supplementary Section 2 on the shift is cited, but the main text still cites the DMI paper for the nonlinear shift.
Still one sample, field, pump frequency and pulse length; no repetition rate given.
Eq. (2) moved from the main text to Supplementary Section 1, which we cannot check.
The 't0' wording is harmonized, but no radial scale or bin width is given.
The caption still says a higher amplitude is observed above 23 dBm.
The Fig. 2b axis now reads −π/2 in the text layer; the Fig. 3a labels and the f_p/2 line cannot be checked from text.
Lateral dimensions and antenna width added; M_s, anisotropy and damping still missing.
Data deposited on Zenodo with source data.
The quantum–classical correspondence statements are unchanged.
The sentence was reworded but still claims the same time resolution as the raw signal.
The down-conversion sentence moved to the Supplementary, which we cannot check.
Methods still give 'Miteq S138BDU1'; the figure labels cannot be checked.
Spelling changed to 'thermalization' and title capitalization fixed, but 'inlays' remains.

unaddressed_major.title: No quantitative phase statistic
unaddressed_major.why: No trace of it in the new version, and the added pump-phase bars suggest referees focused on the reference rather than on statistics.

unaddressed_major.title: Condensation vs parametric threshold
unaddressed_major.why: The Fig. 4 text is untouched; nothing hints that the threshold interpretation was challenged.

unaddressed_major.title: Dephasing claim not measured
unaddressed_major.why: The strong 'does not undergo dephasing' sentence survives unchanged, which a referee who pressed on it would likely have forced to soften.

unaddressed_major.title: IQ-mixer imbalance and artifacts
unaddressed_major.why: The artifacts are still described identically; an answer may sit in the moved Supplementary Section 1 or the response letter.

unaddressed_major.title: Single sample and single parameter set
unaddressed_major.why: Typical for a letter-style paper; authors likely argued that the setup and prior work establish reproducibility.
